title: Ngeli ya U-U (Theme 5: Mshikamano wa kitaifa)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 6 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child knows abstract and mass nouns in u- (umoja, upendo, uji, ugali) are U-U and take u- with no plural.
representations: U-U and U-YA cards to sort

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Uji ___metiwa sukari." Kwa nini "ya" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Nomino za U-U hazina wingi, kwa hiyo hupatana na u- tu: uji umetiwa sukari.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ugali ___meiva sasa." Kwa nini "i" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Nomino za U-U hupatana na u-: ugali umeiva.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ni nomino ipi ni ya ngeli ya U-U?" Kwa nini "kitabu" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Nomino za U-U hupatana na u- na hazina wingi, kama uji.
Nomino za U-U hazina wingi: umoja wetu, uji umepikwa.
